Resolves #19448

A workspace that turns the tear-out lifecycle on but publishes no `crossWindowSortGroup` now says so at projection, once per class. Without a group the tab zones never register with the drag coordinator and no cross-window participation is composed, so a torn-out window can never be dragged back. The Fleet cockpit shipped that way. The warning sits beside #18197's guard in `Workspace#projectDockModel`. It is a warning rather than a throw, so a consumer can upgrade to 13.2 before publishing a group.

Evidence: L2 (unit: the projection guard, red without it) → L2 required (AC-1 to AC-3). Residual: none on #19448. The group is necessary, not sufficient: a landing drop also needs the drag seams Workstation supplies in `VesselWorkspace#getDockParticipationConfig` (embodiment, native suspend / resume / retire). Fleet Manager's return path is neomjs/neo-agent-institution#591 (Emmy), and its installed drag-back receipt is Sophie's.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `DockWorkspace.spec.mjs`, "tear-out without a cross-window sort group is reported once per class": two `NoSortGroupWorkspace` instances, one report naming the class; a blank group (`BlankSortGroupWorkspace`, `''`) is reported too |
| AC-2 | the same arm: `KeptOptInsWorkspace` (publishes `test-cross-window`) and `NoLifecycleWorkspace` add no report |
| AC-3 | Workstation publishes its group in `VesselWorkspace` and `PopupWorkspace` and so never meets the branch; the existing e2e suite runs in CI |

## Deltas from ticket
- `test/playwright/component/apps/dock-popout/app.mjs` enables the lifecycle without a group, so its component runs print the warning once. That is accurate, since the fixture never drags a window back. The fixtures' gate fails on errors, not warnings, and the `components` CI job is the receipt.

## Test Evidence
- Red-first: with the `console.warn` replaced by a no-op, the arm failed (`Expected length: 1, Received length: 0`). After RA-1, the old `== null` predicate fails the widened arm (`Expected length: 2, Received length: 1`). `DockWorkspace.spec.mjs` passes 140 of 140.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] After neomjs/neo-agent-institution#591 lands, a window torn out of the installed FM drags back into the main window and drops there (Sophie's receipt).

So a blank `''` group is reported too. The new control `BlankSortGroupWorkspace` is a distinct class, so its once-per-class warning state starts fresh. The arm now expects two reports, one per class, and still none for the published-group or lifecycle-off fixtures. No default group, no throw.

Red-first: with the old `== null` predicate restored, the arm fails (`Expected length: 2, Received length: 1`). Repaired, `DockWorkspace.spec.mjs` passes 140 of 140.
